sourceText:
Grandma's Baked Beans
By: Stephanie Irwin...
Published: Tuesday, March 30, 2010 - 7:17am

Ingredients




1 pound dry navy beans, soaked over night
1/2 sick butter
1/4 cup rendered bacon fat
1 can Campbell's tomato soup
1/4 cup sugar
salt and pepper to taste
cooked bacon for garnish

Preparation

1 Boil beans for 1-1/2 hour, until skins curl when you blow on them 2 Drain and place in mixing bowl 3 Add all the ingredients except bacon and mix well; 4 Pour into baking dish and topp with cooked bacon slices, cover with foil and bake 1 hour;  remove foil and bake for another 1/2 hour or until beans are tender.  Serve with vinegar on the side!

About


this is a recipe that has been passed down through the generations.  They came from my Mom's side of the family and usually only one person per generation makes them.  I am the bean maker for the family and I bake them in my great, great Grandmother's roasting pan.  Nothing else gets cooked in that pan.  They are a great recipe and surprisingly delicious!  Us Hungarians eat them with cider vinegar!
